insights.headline: MCX gold down 13% in November as bullion slides toward $3,500 ahead of PCE
insights.summary: Spot gold held near $3,522 an ounce in Wednesday trade, close to its 15-month low near $3,500, after falling more than 2% in the previous session, with silver near $40. On MCX, gold has fallen about 13% in November and silver nearly 20%; December gold touched an intraday low of ₹1,20,346 per 10 g and silver fell to ₹1,41,856 per kg. The rupee held near 92.62 against the dollar. Traders price a near-certain December Fed hike and now await US core PCE at 19:00 IST, the next test before the Fed's 9 December decision.
points: Spot gold held near $3,522 an ounce in Wednesday trade, close to the $3,500 level tested on 20 November.
Silver traded near $40 an ounce, its lowest in more than 14 months, after losing over 5% on Tuesday.
MCX gold has fallen about 13% in November and silver nearly 20%; December gold touched ₹1,20,346 per 10 g and silver ₹1,41,856 per kg.
The rupee held near 92.62 against the dollar on foreign inflows and lower crude.
Traders price a 96.4% chance of a December Fed hike; US core PCE is due today at 19:00 IST.

brief.headline: Gold slips below ₹1.21 lakh as Fed hike bets firm
brief.summary: MCX gold fell to ₹1,20,576 per 10 g and silver to ₹1,42,704 per kg as spot gold slid to $3,522 ahead of US core PCE.

bullets.text: Hawkish Fed signals and a near-certain December hike weighed on bullion, with a firm dollar and tariff worries adding pressure.
MCX tracked the global slide, silver falling harder than gold, while a firm rupee softened the blow for Indian buyers.
Watch today: US core PCE at 19:00 IST, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, ahead of its 9 December decision.

trending.title: Gold slips again ahead of US core PCE
trending.summary: MCX gold is down 13% in November and silver nearly 20%, with spot gold near $3,522. A near-certain December Fed hike and planned US tariff rises press on bullion ahead of US core PCE at 19:00 IST.

trending.title: Silver tests major support near $40
trending.summary: Silver traded near $40 an ounce, its lowest in over 14 months, after Tuesday's 5% slide. Analysts cited by Mint call it deeply oversold, with support near $39.50 and the 200-week average at $39.90.

trending.title: MCX tracks the global slide
trending.summary: MCX December gold touched an intraday low of ₹1,20,346 per 10 g and silver fell to ₹1,41,856 per kg, tracking the global slide as Fed hike bets firmed and the dollar stayed strong.

trending.title: Rupee strength softens the blow for Indian buyers
trending.summary: The rupee held near 92.62 against the dollar on foreign inflows and lower crude, cushioning some of the global slide for Indian buyers even as MCX gold and silver fell sharply.

trending.title: Silver's supply picture is turning
trending.summary: The Silver Institute still forecasts a sixth straight annual deficit of about 35 million ounces, but Deutsche Bank says the market could move into surplus in 2027 as solar demand falls.

items.title: MCX rates: Gold crashes 13%, silver plunges 20% in Nov 2026; is worst over? What should precious metals investors do?
items.summary: MCX gold has fallen about 13% in November and silver nearly 20%, pressured by a firm dollar, higher US yields and unwinding long positions. On Wednesday, MCX gold opened near ₹1,22,035 per 10 g and silver near ₹1,45,137 per kg. Analysts cited call both metals deeply oversold; the Silver Institute still sees a 35-million-ounce deficit this year, while Deutsche Bank sees a possible surplus in 2027.

items.title: Gold, silver prices decline on MCX as investors reassess outlook for US interest rates
items.summary: MCX December gold fell to an intraday low of ₹1,20,575 per 10 g and was last seen at ₹1,20,684, down 1.34%, while December silver slipped to ₹1,42,907 per kg, down 1.74%, India TV reports. Spot gold was $3,522.36 an ounce as investors reassessed the outlook for US interest rates ahead of US PCE data.

items.title: What is driving fall in gold, silver & crude oil? Fed rate hike fears weigh
items.summary: Gold stayed under pressure in Wednesday afternoon trade as markets priced a near-certain December Fed hike, with COMEX gold near $3,550 and MCX gold near Rs 1,22,020 per 10 g after Tuesday's sharp fall. Silver held near $40.75 on COMEX and Rs 1,44,890 per kg on MCX, while crude also eased. CME has raised gold and silver futures margins, and traders now await US PCE and GDP data due later today.

items.title: Gold, Silver Lose Shine: Yellow Metal Prices Fall Below Rs 1,21,000; White Metal Rates Under Rs 1,42,000
items.summary: MCX December gold fell ₹1,753, or 1.43%, to ₹1,20,576 per 10 g and silver dropped ₹2,734, or 1.88%, to ₹1,42,704 per kg, NDTV Profit reports, with both metals below the previous session's lows as traders price a December Fed hike ahead of US inflation data.

items.title: Gold ticks lower ahead of US inflation data
items.summary: Spot gold edged 0.3% lower to $3,544.54 an ounce after falling more than 2% in the previous session, as hawkish signals from the US Federal Reserve reinforced expectations of a December rate hike. Traders await US inflation data, the October PCE index due at 19:00 IST, for further policy clues.

items.title: Gold Falls Close to $3,500 a Troy Ounce as Market Awaits Inflation Data
items.summary: US gold futures fell 1.1% to $3,522.30 an ounce in early European trade, putting gold on track for a weekly loss of nearly 6%, as markets priced in a December Fed hike and the US prepared to raise tariffs on China and dozens of other countries. Spot gold was near $3,555 earlier in the session. US PCE inflation data due later on Wednesday is the next key test of the rate outlook.

items.title: Gold Near 15-Month Lows: Why the Next Fed Hike May Not Be the Biggest Risk
items.summary: The December Fed hike is already widely expected, so the bigger risk for gold is how much further tightening follows into 2027, Investing.com argues. Real yields matter most: if Treasury yields rise faster than inflation, holding gold grows costlier. It cites a 96.4% December hike chance, the Fed's 3.75-4.00% rate, September PCE at 3.6% headline and 3.1% core, and Q3 GDP growth of 3.4%.

items.title: Gold (XAUUSD) & Silver Price Forecast: Gold Slips Again as Fed Hike Bets Firm, Can $3,503 Hold?
items.summary: Gold slipped again as firming bets on a December Fed hike weighed on bullion, FXEmpire reports, with $3,503 the support in focus and silver near $40.79 an ounce. Traders price a 96.4% chance of a quarter-point December hike, per CME FedWatch.

items.title: Gold, silver prices trade lower as Fed rate-hike expectations strengthen
items.summary: MCX gold opened at ₹1,22,035 per 10 g, down ₹294, and silver at ₹1,45,137 per kg, down ₹301, with Comex gold near $3,550 an ounce. Business Standard reports traders price a 96.4% chance of a December Fed hike, with US PCE data due later on Wednesday.

items.title: Gold and Silver Slide to Key Support as Rate Hike Fears Build
items.summary: Gold futures gave up $79.30, or 2.18%, reversing the previous session's 2.70% rally, while silver slid after breaking below $50, Kitco reports. Gold futures now test support near $3,500 and silver near $40, with traders pricing a 96.4% chance of a December Fed hike ahead of Wednesday's PCE release.

items.title: Gold falls by ₹3,635/10 gm to ₹1.21 lakh/10 gm: Silver falls by ₹9,103/kg to ₹1.43 lakh/kg
items.summary: IBJA rates show 10 g of 24-carat gold fell ₹3,635 to ₹1.21 lakh and 1 kg of silver fell ₹9,103 to ₹1.43 lakh, a 13-month low, Bhaskar English reports. Gold was ₹1.25 lakh and silver ₹1.53 lakh on November 23.

items.title: Gold slides back closer to YTD lows as bears eye $3,500 amid firmer USD, ahead of US PCE
items.summary: Gold slid back toward its year-to-date lows as a firmer dollar and bets on further Fed tightening kept pressure on bullion ahead of US PCE data, FXStreet's Haresh Menghani writes. A break below the $3,500 level would reaffirm the bearish outlook, with a December hike nearly fully priced.

items.title: Gold Tests $3,515 Support as Iran Conflict Continues to Rattle Oil Markets
items.summary: Gold tested support near $3,515 as the continuing Iran conflict rattled oil markets, Investing.com's analysis notes, with bullion under pressure from firming expectations of further Fed tightening ahead of US PCE data.

items.title: Gold weakens further as tariff worries and rate bets pressure bullion
items.summary: Gold weakened further as tariff worries and bets on further rate rises pressured bullion, Anadolu Agency reports, with spot gold at $3,533 an ounce, down 0.66%, and silver at $40.38, down 1.26%. Traders await the US PCE report at 19:00 IST ahead of the Fed's December 8-9 meeting.

items.title: Silver futures decline to ₹1.44 lakh/kg
items.summary: MCX silver futures for December delivery fell ₹1,184, or 0.81%, to ₹1,44,254 per kg, BusinessLine reports, with global silver at $40.70 an ounce in New York, down 0.40%.

items.title: Gold price tracker, Nov 25: MCX gold and silver prices fall up to 1% amid weak global cues; what's in focus next?
items.summary: MCX December gold fell ₹915, or 0.74%, to a morning low of ₹1,21,414 per 10 g, while silver slid ₹1,518 per kg to ₹1,43,920, as traders awaited US PCE inflation data. Upstox reports the 10-year US Treasury yield held near 4.9% as hawkish Fed commentary kept December hike bets firm.

items.title: Gold & Silver Rates: MCX gold slumps by Rs 3,671, silver crashes 6% amid growing Fed hike bets
items.summary: MCX December gold fell as much as Rs 3,671, or 2.9%, to Rs 1,22,325 in the evening session and was down 2.8% at Rs 1,22,505 late in the day; December silver slid as much as Rs 9,253, or 6%, to Rs 1,44,964. Zee Business links the slide to growing bets on further Fed rate hikes and a firm dollar.

items.title: Silver Prices Fall as Hawkish Fed Signals Build Ahead of U.S. PCE Inflation Data
items.summary: Silver settled 5.69% lower at ₹1,45,438 per kg, down ₹8,779, as hawkish Fed signals built ahead of US PCE inflation data. Kedia Advisory cites a 93.5% chance of a December hike; Metals Focus forecasts global silver demand falling 5% to 1.08 billion ounces in 2026.

items.title: Silver (XAG/USD) Price Forecast: Deepening Selloff Puts Major Support to the Test
items.summary: Silver fell to a low of $40.73 in Tuesday's session, failing to hold the prior low of $40.77, as sellers stayed in control since the $53.73 swing high two weeks ago, FXEmpire reports. The metal now tests a major support zone anchored by the July 2025 high of $39.53 and the 200-week moving average near $39.90, with daily RSI at its lowest since February 2023.

items.title: Rupee jumps 23 paise to 92.62 against US dollar in early trade
items.summary: The rupee rose 23 paise to 92.62 against the dollar in early trade, PTI reports, helped by foreign-fund inflows, a rally in domestic equities and Brent crude down 1.3%. The currency has gained over 1.6% in five sessions since 94.19 on 13 November, though a strong dollar capped further gains.

items.title: Gold Sinks with AI, Silver Extends Worst Drop Since Lehmans as 'Fed Mistake' Looms
items.summary: Gold fell back to $3,560 an ounce, giving back $125 of Monday's $150 rebound, while silver dropped to $40.76, a new 14-month low and its steepest 13-week fall since the Lehman crash of 2008. BullionVault cites rising Fed hike expectations, with traders putting a 97% chance on a December rise, and quotes Bill Ackman calling a December hike a 'mistake'.

items.title: Silver miners struggle to close persistent supply gap
items.summary: Silver mine output is set to stay flat in 2026 despite a sixth straight annual deficit, with demand forecast to exceed supply by 35 million oz, Metals Focus estimates. Primary mines supply just 26.1% of output, the rest a byproduct of other metals mines, so higher prices alone are not lifting production. Weaker solar demand could tip the market into surplus in 2027, Deutsche Bank notes.

items.title: Pledged gold worth less as prices crash 30% from peak; gold loan NPAs nearly double, RBI cautions NBFCs
items.summary: Gold loan NPAs nearly doubled in six months, the ratio rising to 0.3% at the end of August from 0.16% in March, TransUnion CIBIL data cited in the report shows. With gold down nearly 30% from its peak near Rs 1.80 lakh, pledged gold is worth less and loan-to-value ratios are under pressure. The RBI has asked NBFCs to tighten scrutiny of gold-loan books and warned against rapid expansion.
